assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape background for a hand-painted 2D fantasy game called Forest Keeper. A quiet ancient forest at blue twilight, enormous mossy trees, layered fern silhouettes, distant stone arch, fireflies and warm amber lantern glow among muted teal foliage. Painterly storybook illustration with clear big shapes, delicate textured edges, game-ready readable composition. Wide panoramic landscape, no characters, no text, no UI, no watermarks. Dark navy and forest green base; warm golden accents, not bright. Usable as both main menu background and side-scrolling forest scenery. Fill frame, landscape 3:2 or wider.
